title: It’s hot today
simplified_paragraphs: 今天天气很热， 早上中文老师上了三节课， 非常渴。 她去超市买了一瓶水， 又回办公室喝了两杯茶， 舒服多了。
traditional_paragraphs: 今天天氣很熱， 早上中文老師上了三節課， 非常渴。 她去超市買了一瓶水， 又回辦公室喝了兩杯茶， 舒服多了。
pinyin_paragraphs: jīn tiān tiān qì hěn rè，  zǎo shang Zhōng wén lǎo shī shàng le sān jié kè，  fēi cháng kě。  tā qù chāo shì mǎi le yī píng shuǐ，  yòu huí bàn gōng shì hē le liǎng bēi chá，  shū fu duō le。
english_paragraphs: The weather is very hot today. The Chinese teacher had three classes in the morning and I am very thirsty. She went to the supermarket to buy a bottle of water, then went back to the office and drank two cups of tea. She felt much better.
english_full: The weather is very hot today. The Chinese teacher had three classes in the morning and I am very thirsty. She went to the supermarket to buy a bottle of water, then went back to the office and drank two cups of tea. She felt much better.
